title: RBI may opt for 25 bps rate hike as oil eases, inflation risks persist: Baroda BNP Paribas MF CIO - The Economic Times
text:
The Reserve Bank of India is projected to implement a 0.25 percent interest rate hike in December. While decreasing crude oil prices could alleviate some inflation worries, many senior executives advocate for a measured strategy due to the prevailing economic climate. Nevertheless, concerns regarding food inflation and supply chain issues persist, adversely influencing overall forecasts.
